# TPC-Havoc Q5_v1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  n_name,
  (
    SELECT
      SUM(l2.l_extendedprice * (
        1 - l2.l_discount
      ))
    FROM lineitem AS l2, orders AS o2, customer AS c2, supplier AS s2
    WHERE
      l2.l_orderkey = o2.o_orderkey
      AND o2.o_custkey = c2.c_custkey
      AND l2.l_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey
      AND c2.c_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey
      AND s2.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
      AND o2.o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND o2.o_orderdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
  ) AS revenue
FROM nation AS n1, region
WHERE
  n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey
  AND r_name = 'ASIA'
  AND EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM lineitem, orders, customer, supplier
    WHERE
      l_orderkey = o_orderkey
      AND o_custkey = c_custkey
      AND l_suppkey = s_suppkey
      AND c_nationkey = s_nationkey
      AND s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
      AND o_orderdate >= CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND o_orderdate < CAST('1994-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR'
  )
ORDER BY
  revenue DESC
```
